pages.title: Flashing Space Hopper
pages.description: Get active with this motion-activated light-up space hopper! Fun, junior-sized bouncing toy from Cogs Toys & Games Ireland. Perfect for active play.
pages.ld_description:
Flashing Space Hopper


Junior-sized translucent space hopper with built-in LED lights that flash when bouncing


Motion-activated light-up balls inside create a dazzling effect with every hop 🌟


Inflates to approx. 60 cm—just the right size for younger kids


Encourages active play, balance, and coordination indoors or outdoors


Durable and fun for energetic bouncers aged 5 and up


Bounce, flash, and laugh with the light-up Space Hopper! A brilliant way to burn off energy and brighten playtime.
